map.→ 打开管径计算（重力流/压力流）工具: -> Open the pipe diameter calculator (gravity flow / pressure flow) tool
map.与管材和新旧程度有关：新铸铁管 C≈130、旧铸铁管 C≈100、PVC 约 1: It depends on the pipe material and age: new cast iron C≈130, old cast iron C≈100, PVC about 140-150, concrete about 100-120; the Manning roughness n is about 0.011-0.013 for new pipe and can exceed 0.015 for old pipe. The tool fills this in automatically from the selected pipe material.
map.为什么推荐取相邻标准 DN？: Why is it recommended to pick an adjacent standard DN?
map.压力流与重力流怎么选？: How do you choose between pressure flow and gravity flow?
map.压力流（Hazen-Williams）：D = [10.67·L·Q^1.852: Pressure flow (Hazen-Williams): D = [10.67·L·Q^1.852 / (C^1.852·hf)]^(1/4.87); gravity flow (Manning): D = [Q·4·n·4^(2/3) / (π·√S)]^(3/8); velocity V = Q / (πD²/4); Reynolds number Re = V·D / ν
map.压力管道选径：给定流量与允许水头损失，按 Hazen-Williams 反算内径: Pressure pipe sizing: given the flow and the allowable head loss, back-calculate the internal diameter with Hazen-Williams and pick a standard DN.
map.已有管道校核：算出流速与雷诺数，判断是否落在经济流速区间、流态是否合理。: Check an existing pipe: compute the velocity and Reynolds number and judge whether it falls in the economical velocity range and whether the flow state is reasonable.
map.按压力流（Hazen-Williams）或重力流（Manning）两类工况，由设: For pressure flow (Hazen-Williams) or gravity flow (Manning), back-calculate the required diameter from the design flow, water temperature, pipe length and pipe material, and recommend the adjacent standard DN size.
map.有泵加压输送选压力流，按 Hazen-Williams 以允许水头损失反算管径；: Choose pressure flow when a pump pressurises the transfer, sizing the pipe with Hazen-Williams from the allowable head loss; choose gravity flow when the terrain height difference drives the flow, sizing with Manning from the bed slope. The roughness coefficients mean different things: the former uses C (larger is smoother), the latter uses n (smaller is smoother).
map.液压缸推力速度行程计算: Hydraulic cylinder thrust, speed and stroke calculation
map.由设计流量反算管径，分两类工况：压力流按 Hazen-Williams 公式以流: Back-calculate the diameter from the design flow, split into two cases: for pressure flow use Hazen-Williams with the flow, length, roughness coefficient C and allowable head loss; for gravity flow use Manning with the flow, roughness n and bed slope S. Once the theoretical internal diameter is found, round up to the standard DN series and report the velocity and Reynolds number for checking the flow state. The water temperature is used to look up the kinematic viscosity for the Reynolds number.
map.算得的理论内径通常不是标准值，实际需按 DN 序列选取；选小会提高流速、增大水头: The computed theoretical internal diameter is usually not a standard size, so the DN series is used in practice; choosing smaller raises the velocity and increases head loss and noise, while choosing larger raises the investment, so the adjacent standard sizes are given with the velocity for weighing up.
map.管径计算（重力流/压力流） 使用指南: How to use the pipe diameter calculator (gravity flow / pressure flow)
map.粗糙系数怎么取？: How is the roughness coefficient chosen?
map.重力流管道选径：给定流量与底坡，按 Manning 公式求管径，用于自流输水与排: Gravity flow pipe sizing: given the flow and the bed slope, find the diameter with the Manning formula, for gravity-fed water transfer and drainage.
map.：流量 30 L/s、管长 500 m、水温 20 ℃、旧铸铁管 C = 100: : flow 30 L/s, pipe length 500 m, water temperature 20 degC, old cast iron C = 100 and allowable head loss 5 m: Hazen-Williams gives a theoretical internal diameter of about 191 mm, rounded up to the standard DN200; the corresponding velocity = 0.03 / (pi x 0.2²/4) ≈ 0.96 m/s, inside the 0.6-1.5 m/s economical range, so the diameter is sensible.
